name: Starter Pack's Gambit
author: Agent15
summary: Buying a gambit in the shop also earns a piece of each synergy it belongs to.
description: A cheap common that pays you back for shopping. Every time you buy a gambit, this one looks at that gambit's synergies (PAWN, ROOK, KNIGHT, BISHOP, QUEEN, KING) and adds a matching piece to your stock for each one - so a two-synergy card hands you two pieces. Gambits with no piece synergy give nothing, and nothing is added once your stock is full. Needs the Gambit Creation API, which installs automatically.
